name: plainly
description: Inject selectable plain-language response styles before each AI turn.

interface.shortDescription: Clear, selectable response styles for every turn
interface.longDescription: Plainly injects a selected communication style immediately before the AI processes each user prompt. It includes four built-in profiles and supports user, project, environment, and external-file configuration without post-answer retries.
defaultPrompt: Set Plainly to the brief style.
Use this custom style file with Plainly.
